hypotheses.text: If Mateo Brann (CF) had been 3 m closer to Theo Varga, his added close pressure would have reduced Varga’s shooting space and thereby significantly lowered the chance to score, likely preventing the goal.

If Noah Fairley (RB) had been 5 m closer to Theo Varga, his quicker approach from the flank would have closed the shooting angle or forced a rushed/blocked attempt, reducing the chance to score and possibly stopping the goal.
